question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), point \(D\) lies on the extension of \(BC\). Given \(\angle ACD=130^\circ\) and \(\angle A=50^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle B\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: \(\angle ACD\) is an exterior angle of \(\triangle ABC\), so \(\angle ACD=\angle A+\angle B\). Therefore, \(\angle B=130^\circ-50^\circ=80^\circ\).
solutions.title: Use the exterior-angle equation
